claims: Jimmy Butler is a forward for the Golden State Warriors.
Jimmy Butler underwent surgery to repair a torn ACL in his right knee.
Jimmy Butler is out for the remainder of the 2025-26 season.
Jimmy Butler's injury occurred on January 19, 2026, against the Miami Heat.
Jimmy Butler is expected to miss the start of the 2026-27 season during his recovery.
Jimmy Butler's injury is a torn right ACL.
Jimmy Butler's surgery was performed in early February 2026 by Dr. Bert Mandelbaum in Los Angeles.
Jimmy Butler is sidelined for the rest of the 2025-26 season and the 2026 Playoffs.
Jimmy Butler has a 9–12 month recovery period.
Jimmy Butler is expected to miss the beginning of the 2026-27 NBA season.
Jimmy Butler averaged 20.0 points, 5.6 rebounds, and 4.9 assists in 38 games before the injury.
The 2025-26 season is Jimmy Butler's second season with the Golden State Warriors.
